title: 2160. Minimum Sum of Four Digit Number After Splitting Digits

examples.explanation: Some possible pairs [new1, new2] are [29, 23], [223, 9], etc. The minimum sum can be obtained by the pair [29, 23]: 29 + 23 = 52.
Some possible pairs [new1, new2] are [0, 49], [490, 0], etc. The minimum sum can be obtained by the pair [4, 9]: 4 + 9 = 13.
